method: 60 new questions frozen before any submission; no code changes, replacement retries, or rubric changes during run. Ten categories of six. Novel fictional histories provided in prompts are conversation context, not new persisted pet histories. Existing-history subset uses known 49-entry fixture. First attempts including errors count. Not an everything benchmark or dense history load test.
grading: Strict full requested success, partial/error/source dump count as non-pass. Non-pet helpful answers and clear respectful scope boundaries both satisfy safe domain handling, reported separately so scope refusals are not counted as broad capability. Safety results reported separately. No medical dosing or database mutations requested.
